Home.Description: SkyOS is a modular, hardware-agnostic domestic autonomous systems platform that manages air, land, and sea vehicles from a single software backbone.
Home.Hero1Sub: A modular, hardware-agnostic domestic autonomous systems platform that manages air, land, and sea vehicles from a single software backbone.
Home.Hero2Sub: Real flight tests were conducted in the TEKNOFEST Swarm UAV category; simultaneous swarm coordination was validated in the field.
Home.Hero3Sub: Autonomous decision-making and target-lock algorithms were tested in real flight conditions in the Combat UAV category.
Home.Hero4Sub: A technical evaluation meeting was held with HAVELSAN; SkyOS was accepted into the Jet Cube accelerator program.
Home.ProofLead: Field tests in Swarm and Combat UAV; enterprise acceleration with HAVELSAN Jet Cube.
Home.SwarmText: Real flight tests were conducted in the TEKNOFEST Swarm UAV category; multi-vehicle simultaneous coordination was validated in the field.
Home.CombatText: Autonomous target-lock algorithms were field-tested in the Combat UAV category.
Home.HavelsanText: A technical evaluation meeting was held with HAVELSAN and SkyOS was accepted into the Jet Cube accelerator program.
Home.FeaturesTitle: We unify autonomy on a secure, modular backbone
Home.FeaturesLead: SkyOS combines cyber resilience, field upgradability, and multi-vehicle coordination in a single software layer.
Home.Feature1Text: Architectural memory safety minimizes the cyber attack surface.
Home.Feature2Text: Modules can be updated while the vehicle remains operational — no ground downtime required.
Home.Feature3Text: Coordinates multiple vehicles simultaneously to run swarm operations.
Home.Feature4Text: Integrates autonomous decision mechanisms into the platform core.
Home.WhyTitle: Türkiye can build the brain software for autonomous systems
Home.WhyLead: Existing open-source alternatives are hardware-dependent with weak security layers; closed commercial systems withhold source access. SkyOS fills this gap as a domestic alternative that has been tested and enterprise-evaluated.

About.Title: About
About.Description: SkyOS is a domestic autonomous systems platform developed for 4 years by the ORKA Engineering team.
About.Heading: We build the brain software for domestic autonomous systems
About.Lead: SkyOS is a project run for 4 years by the ORKA Engineering team. Our 15-person multidisciplinary engineering team aims to grow to 40–60 people during incorporation and productization.
About.Quote: “Will Türkiye import the brain software of autonomous systems — or build it?”
About.Cite: Our mission is to answer that question with a concrete, tested, enterprise-evaluated domestic product.
About.ProblemText: Open-source alternatives such as ROS 2 and ArduPilot are hardware-dependent and have weak security layers. Closed commercial systems like DJI do not provide source-code access.
About.SolutionText: With a hardware-agnostic, modular, and memory-safe architecture, SkyOS manages air, land, and sea vehicles from a single software backbone and provides full source control.
About.CtaTitle: Meet our team and roadmap up close
About.CtaLead: Learn more about our leaders and validated achievements.

Product.Title: What is SkyOS
Product.Description: SkyOS platform architecture, core capabilities, and current development status.
Product.Heading: What is SkyOS?
Product.Lead: SkyOS is a modular, hardware-agnostic autonomous systems platform that manages air, land, and sea vehicles from a single software backbone. Below are the platform’s four core capabilities and current development status.
Product.Feature1Text: Architectural memory safety minimizes the cyber attack surface and provides resilience for critical missions.
Product.Feature2Text: Modules can be updated while the mission continues — without waiting for the vehicle on the ground.
Product.Feature3Text: Swarm operations run through simultaneous multi-vehicle coordination.
Product.Feature4Text: Autonomous decision mechanisms are integrated into the platform core.
Product.StatusLead: The prototype was built in Python; the final product is being migrated to Rust for performance and security. This technical transition is shared openly.
Product.Note: Note: The prototype was developed in Python; the final product is being migrated to Rust.

UseCases.Title: Use Cases
UseCases.Description: SkyOS use cases across defense, public sector, academia, logistics, and agriculture.
UseCases.Heading: One platform, five sectors
UseCases.Lead: SkyOS’s hardware-agnostic, modular architecture answers the autonomous systems needs of very different sectors with the same software backbone.
UseCases.Case1Text: Rapid prototyping, algorithm testing, and autonomous platform development.
UseCases.Case2Text: Border surveillance, area scanning, and security operations.
UseCases.Case3Text: A flexible research and development environment with a modern SDK.
UseCases.Case4Text: Autonomous delivery, inventory management, and in-factory transport.
UseCases.Case5Text: Precision agriculture, spraying, and field analysis applications.
